top_story: Israel’s decision on 4 June to press ahead with ground operations in southern Lebanon despite a ceasefire gave way on 5 June to airstrikes and evacuation orders for nine villages, displacing thousands and hardening Hezbollah’s refusal to accept terms that leave Israeli forces in place. Set against Tehran’s earlier vow to escalate regionally if directly threatened, the latest Israeli actions point to a more combustible regional environment in which local military moves are increasing civilian harm and narrowing off-ramps.
